title: Invitation Homes Names Executive Vice Presidents
summary: New roles sharpen focus on disciplined capital allocation and resident experience Invitation Homes Inc. (NYSE: INVH) (“Invitation Homes” or the “Company”) today announced leadership changes. These appointments align leadership accountability with two key strategic priorities: optimizing long-term portfolio performance and delivering an exceptional resident experience. Peter DiLello is now Executive Vice President, Investment Management Group. One of the most tenured leaders at Invitation Homes, Peter has been with the Company since its earliest days and has been instrumental in its growth and evolution. He has led several critical functions, including investments, dispositions, construction lending, and transaction management. As disciplined capital allocation, portfolio optimization, and investment strategy become increasingly important drivers of long-term value creation, Peter’s leadership will continue to play a critical role in the Company’s success.
